authorization: User explicitly requested assistant document relevance judgments; human approval is not a prerequisite
historical_status: Exact draft bytes preserved, including historical human-review status. This protocol authorizes AI assessment; no human review is claimed.

judgment_policy.grades: 0 irrelevant/constraint violation; 1 relevant limited detail; 2 directly relevant substantive evidence
judgment_policy.hard_constraints: All mandatory inclusion constraints apply; omission alone is not proof of negation
judgment_policy.temporal: Inclusive event windows; date must be supported in article text; publication dates unavailable
judgment_policy.mixed_articles: An article may discuss opposing findings; judge whether it supplies the requested evidence, not whether every passage supports it
judgment_policy.uncertainty: Leave unresolved candidates unassessed; do not silently turn uncertainty into grade 0
judgment_policy.evidence: Read full title and body; retain exact quotations and Unicode character offsets into (title + newline + body).strip()
judgment_policy.blinding: Article packets omit engine/rank/score. Assessor has seen some prior results; perfect blindness is not claimed.
judgment_policy.freeze_timing: Queries were drafted before retrieval. This protocol follows retrieval and an H01 article preview; it is not a preregistration.
judgment_policy.independence: AI diagnostic labels, not human gold. No independent inter-assessor agreement is claimed.

evaluation_policy.ndcg: Linear 0–2 gains; report only for queries with complete top-five union judgments; ideal ranking uses assessed pool positives
evaluation_policy.map: MAP@1000 only after the designated pool is complete; shallow-pool estimate, unassessed != confirmed irrelevant
evaluation_policy.pilot: Partial query coverage must be explicit; never publish a partial pilot as a 20-query aggregate
evaluation_policy.original_qrels: Do not change or merge the original 57-query qrels
